research_conclusions: SBI's approximately 9% Ripple equity stake is distinct from SBI's XRP holdings, Ripple's own XRP treasury and escrow.
SBI's $200M Evernorth PIPE cash investment is an identifiable capital contribution; Evernorth's >$1B mixed cash/XRP total is not all SBI capital.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD channel was Ethereum-only for deposits and withdrawals at launch; it is not proof of an XRPL RLUSD rail through SBI.
Circle SBI Japan K.K. is a separate USDC distribution JV and had no significant operating results by 2026-09-30.
Circle Mint net fiat flows are a better actual-capital measure than gross onchain transaction volume, but they cover only Circle Mint customers.
Coinbase's Circle distribution compensation is a material expense/revenue relationship, not XRP demand.
SBI Ripple Asia's 2026 XRPL work is research/POC; production settlement volumes are not established.
